_comment: Never the same twice: the land changes more as it is crossed, its height drifting further, its outlines
bending more, its wear swinging wider and its landmarks standing closer together. The plain word against
`uniform`, which holds it the same everywhere.
`varied biomes` are smaller, so more of them are in sight at once.
`varied inhabitants` (Jonah): each biome's creatures evened out, and joined by a few from biomes of a climate like
its own. `varied structures`: each may stand in the biomes of a climate like its own home's, short of `jumbled`.
